metadata.title: Gritty Grunge Album Cover with Splatter Overlay

retrievalProfile.description: A distressed, sepia-toned band portrait featuring aggressive white paint splatters and vertical display typography along the right margin.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a group of figures in a desaturated, sepia-toned industrial setting. The image is heavily modified by large, diagonal white paint splatters and ink drips that partially obscure the subjects. Bold, sans-serif typography is oriented vertically along the right edge, while a secondary text block is contained within a colored rectangular sticker in the upper left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Sepia-toned photography vs. high-contrast white overlays
Rough industrial textures vs. clean geometric text blocks
Foreground figures vs. receding corrugated metal background
coreInvariants: Vertical text orientation on the right margin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four figures arranged in a staggered horizontal line across the middle ground, scaled to fill the vertical height of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical text on the right edge acts as a structural anchor, balanced by the rectangular sticker in the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal splatter from bottom left to top right, then drops down the vertical text on the right edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Occupied by heavy white splatter and distressed textures, creating a 'busy' rather than 'empty' negative space.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout with high value contrast between the dark shadows and the white splatter.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones and high-contrast white

characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical stacking of characters for the right-side title
Condensed proportions to fit narrow margins
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A bold condensed sans-serif for the main title paired with a smaller, lighter version of the same family for the sticker text.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, industrial feel of the display text.
Provides a similar grotesque aesthetic with high legibility.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned photograph of a band standing in front of a corrugated metal wall. Apply a heavy, diagonal white paint splatter effect from the bottom left to the top right, including drips and ink spots. Add a weathered, distressed paper texture over the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a vertical column of bold, condensed sans-serif uppercase text along the right edge. In the top left corner, place a muted red rectangular box containing smaller sans-serif text aligned to the center.

verificationChecks: Is the main title text oriented vertically on the right?
Is the white splatter diagonal and high-contrast?
Is the overall color palette sepia/desaturated?
Is there a rectangular sticker element in the top left?

adjustableVariables: Hue of the sepia tone (warmer vs. cooler)
Number of figures in the portrait
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific band name or song titles from the original
Do not replicate the exact logo or star icon
Ensure the splatter pattern is unique and not a direct trace

avoid: Default horizontal typesetting for the main title

postGenerationChecks: Verify text is uppercase and condensed
Ensure splatter overlaps the subjects naturally
Confirm the sepia tone is consistent across the image
recipe.reuseFormula: Sepia Band Portrait + Diagonal White Splatter Overlay + Vertical Condensed Sans-Serif Title + Top-Left Hype Sticker
